rationale: Connect Trafft, Plutio, Encharge, and the Party model using the strongest available deterministic evidence, then classify the unresolved remainder explicitly as legacy. This authorizes read-only provider discovery and batch lookup, durable provider-scoped Party references, bounded reconciliation observations and receipts, historical Trafft binding when a customer ID maps to one canonical Party and is corroborated by an exact unique Plutio contact or another stable provider reference, operational opt-in to existing shared read tooling, independently reviewed implementation, exact release deployment, and aggregate live verification. Evidence tiers must remain explicit; conflicting or multiply mapped identifiers may not be forced. This does not authorize provider record mutation, contact upsert/archive/unsubscribe, email or campaign sends, consent changes, Plutio writes, Party merges, customer communication, payment or contract action, broad minion access, or treating Encharge marketing state as learning, appointment, or relationship authority.
source_task: Current owner instruction in Codex: do your best and connect them all; whatever remains will be called legacy, following clarification about Plutio and Encharge.
